tavi.name: Tavi
tavi.bio: Babylonian sage who raised a contradiction between two mishnayot before Rav Naḥman and reported Rav Sheshet’s answer to it (Temurah 34a).
tavi.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 30s with a short dark beard and a plain grey-brown wool mantle, holding up two fingers as he sets one teaching against another; background of a mud-brick study hall with an oil lamp.

rav-pinchas.name: Rav Pineḥas
rav-pinchas.bio: Babylonian Amora who raises an objection from a baraita in the Gemara (Temurah 34a).
rav-pinchas.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a dark blue wool mantle, raising one hand as he cites a baraita in objection; background of mud-brick academy walls and oil lamps.

rav-shemaya.name: Rav Shemaya
rav-shemaya.bio: Babylonian Amora who explains that a baraita forbidding the ash of consecrated property speaks of the ashes removed from the altar (Temurah 34a).
rav-shemaya.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a full brown beard and a sand-coloured wool mantle, speaking calmly with an open palm turned upward; background of a study hall with mud-brick walls and a single oil lamp.
